answer: Treating static keys as an obsolete relic, a Proof-of-SpaceTime registry defends an AI-agent economy by requiring each agent to seal a key-salted dataset via depth-robust graphs and pass random Merkle audits each epoch. Attackers incur the verifiable cost of dedicated disk capacity and read IOPS per identity, as unique replicas cannot be shared or recomputed within audit timeouts. Yet cheap bulk storage farms can still hollow out this marble defense like a karst, hiding clusters of fake agents.
